core_obligations: Continuity (proof lines 375-377): u is continuous - preimages of opens are opens and Zariski coverings pull back to Zariski coverings, so the adjoint pair f_{Zar,*} = u^s, f_{Zar}^{-1} = u_s exists.

The indexing categories (lines 380-388): I_V^u consists of pairs (U, varphi) with varphi : [m] -> [n], U in X_m open and Y(varphi)(V) in f_m^{-1}(U); morphisms are psi : [m'] -> [m] with X(psi)(U) in U' and varphi psi = varphi'; exactness of u_s reduces to cofilteredness of I_V^u.

Cofilteredness (lines 390-411): condition (1) holds since (X_n, id_[n]) is an object; condition (2) holds because the constraint is equivalent to V in f_n^{-1}(X(varphi)^{-1}(U)), giving a map (X(varphi)^{-1}(U), id) -> (U, varphi), and (U cap U', id) maps to any two objects over id_[n]; condition (3) holds since precomposing with (X(varphi)^{-1}(U), id) -> (U, varphi) equalizes any two parallel morphisms because varphi psi = varphi' = varphi psi'.
proof_roadmap: Observe continuity of the open-preimage functor.
Describe the indexing categories I_V^u and reduce exactness of u_s to cofilteredness.
Verify the three codirected-category conditions explicitly.
difficulty_reason: Site-morphism lemma (statement 366-373, proof 375-411): continuity is definitional for the Zariski topology of simplicial spaces, and exactness of the stalk functor is proven by an explicit verification of all three cofilteredness conditions on the displayed indexing categories; no condition is skipped. H2: elementary site-theoretic verification.
